correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from Berardi Gili's Definitions 7--10, closure Lemmas 2--3, canonical-model Lemmas 4--5, and completeness theorem. Closure disjunct representations are exactly nonempty unions of original representations, and every nonempty union-closed family is realized. The recurrence removes lower-degree duplicates and gives the checked values \(R_0=2\), \(R_1=8\), \(R_2=512\) for one variable. Applying the published 12-element Frankl theorem then yields the majority representative on the stated fragments. The external 12-element exhaustive computation was not independently replayed, so the claim relies on that published theorem as a premise.

value.rationale: The result converts a new modal hyperintensional normal-form construction into a standard extremal-combinatorics object and transfers a strong finite Frankl theorem back to logic. The majority canonical literal is a structural invariant of every exact-equivalence class in explicit shallow fragments, and the representative recurrence makes the transfer boundary transparent. This is not a mere renaming: it connects two literatures and gives an immediately reusable mechanism for importing future finite Frankl bounds.
